summary: Rocket Lab Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $1,944,369,826 of common stock, replacing a prior $3.0 billion sales agreement. The company has already sold $1.0556 billion under the prior agreement. The offering will be conducted through sales agents Deutsche Bank Securities and Wells Fargo Securities, with forward sale agreements allowing deferred settlement. Proceeds are not specified in the excerpt. This is a routine capital-raising transaction via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for future pricing and share issuance under the ATM facility.
